Subject: Quick clarification + pressure-test window for our ISO/FedRAMP intake

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the intake call yesterday. BigBank is trying to schedule a short operational "pressure test" to validate Redwood's evidence packaging and incident/logging handoff ahead of our SIG/CAIQ review and the formal ISO scoping meeting. Two quick asks so we can line up internal teams: 

1) Can you share an inventory of operational dependencies we will need to validate during the pressure test (3rd-party onboarding, KMS, centralized logging, snapshot access points)?
2) What is Redwood's recommended duration for a single pressure-test run (we were thinking 2–4 hours) and which control owners should we expect to engage?

If possible, please attach any sample artifacts or a short checklist so our security ops and audit teams can prepare. Prefer to run the test the week of July 6 — is that feasible?

Patricia
Head of Third‑Party Risk
BigBank

Patricia — thanks, this is a good next step. High level answers below and we can follow up with a short run‑book for the July window. I'll loop in control owners and evidence leads.

- Inventory scope (short): KMS/HSM key wrap operations, service-to-service auth (mTLS), centralized logging (ELK/CloudWatch forwarding), snapshot access (enclave snapshots for Private deployments), identity audit trails, retention/export for dry‑run snapshots.
- Suggested duration: 3 hours minimum, 4–6 hours if you want room for artifact collection and a short table‑top of incident escalation.
- Owners to have on call: Kimberly (controls + evidence), Rishi (platform logging & retention), Priyom (SIG/CAIQ + control narratives).

Kimberly — can you attach the current control-owner matrix and call out any known regional/3P blockers?
Rishi — quick confirmation on retention/export windows and sample log extraction process?
Priyom — can you surface the latest CAIQ/SIG answers and any sample export bundle we can hand to Patricia?

Evelyn

Quick technical notes for the log/export side: 

- Retention: Default platform audit logs are retained for 90 days; cold archives available at 2 years on request (we can include extracts). For FedRAMP scoping BigBank usually requests 1 year — we can provide a 90‑day live extract + archival proof statements.
- Extraction: We provide time-bounded log bundles (JSONL) and a sample pipeline to filter by request_id/session_id. For the pressure test we'll pre-provision a sample export endpoint and credentials.
- Snapshot access: For Private deployments we use read-only enclave snapshots; we will need the BigBank testing VM to have ip allowlist entries.

I'll attach the log retention policy and a short extraction runbook.

Rishi
Principal Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference
